changes.title: Sparkler pulse
items: The pulse on the ley line burns like a sparkler: a bright crackling tip spitting sparks, the line ahead an unlit fuse and the line behind burnt to ash, still showing the way home

changes.title: Legend outline circle
items: A sleeping legend shows its glowing outline only while you are inside its circle; outside, it is a mossy boulder in its clearing

changes.title: Needle drop sound
items: After the party spell, the witch drops the needle on her record and does a little scratching routine behind her decks
Back at her decks after a knockout, she scratches a little while she waits
